gates.purpose: Prevent duplicate user keys from multiplying JOIN results.
Prevent duplicate transaction identifiers from double counting orders.
Detect transaction rows that cannot resolve to an allowed user key.
Validate completion timestamps required by completed-state analysis.
Reject null or non-positive amounts and invalid fees before amount aggregation.
Prevent duplicate exchange-rate keys from multiplying converted values.
Require conversion coverage for every asset used by converted-value analysis.
Require JOIN row-count preservation before user-enriched aggregation.
Compare encoded order dates with created_at when the identifier contains a date.
